selected_skill.purpose: Guide the solver through search, candidate inspection, file retrieval, and manifest-oriented model packaging for printable craft tools.
task_design_intent: Keep the instruction focused on bundle assembly, delivery contract, policy checks, and prohibitions.
Move the search and retrieval workflow pressure into the bound skill and the verifier.
Keep with_skill and without_skill aligned everywhere except environment/skills and its copy path.

skillsmp_references.name: find-stl
skillsmp_references.relevance: searching and fetching printable model files with attribution and license data

skillsmp_references.name: canvas-design
skillsmp_references.relevance: adjacent arts-crafts delivery skill focused on final artifacts

skillsmp_references.name: openscad
skillsmp_references.relevance: adjacent maker workflow skill for printable objects

local_services: HTTPS GraphQL-compatible model source service bound to api.printables.com
local file delivery routes for downloadable packs and individual model files
data_properties: public input files under /root/environment/data provide slot briefs, candidate hints, and policy rules
service seed holds richer model metadata and downloadable artifacts used for final packaging
selection requires combining slot semantics, popularity checks, license checks, and downloaded file evidence

principles: State the operator-facing bundle goal and required deliverables first.
Describe public inputs and the presence of a local model source chain without exposing the GraphQL workflow.
Avoid naming the bound script, command syntax, or internal service routes in the instruction.
Explicitly prohibit replacing the source chain, hardcoding checksums, or modifying task data.
expected_solver_discovery: Recognize that candidate hints alone are insufficient and that the local source chain must be queried.
Decide to consult the bundled skill or manually reconstruct its workflow.
Fetch model files for the chosen bundle and carry file evidence forward into the output records.

main_tests: selection recomputation from policy and service data
downloaded file inventory and hash checks against the mirrored artifacts
bundle-level summary consistency and report structure
guardrails: service access logs prove the solver used search, model detail, download-link, and file routes
public data, hidden service code, and mirrored artifacts remain unchanged
local HTTPS source service remains healthy at verifier end
skill consultation checks stay optional so without_skill still builds and runs
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should center on skipped retrieval actions, incomplete source usage, wrong model selection, or missing downloaded evidence, not narrow formatting issues.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every run must use a fresh runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize README metrics until oracle and at least three valid with-skill/without-skill comparison runs have been collected.
